answer: Require every agent to stake 500 POA locked for 30 days before earning, bound to one verified device and one on-chain history. A farm of 1,000 fakes then costs 500,000 POA plus a month of illiquidity. A nebula of new accounts trading only with each other, sharing one mesa of funders, or repeating identical timing is flagged when mutual traffic exceeds 70 percent or 20 accounts share one funder. Auditors check one pearl, a genuine outside transaction, and if none exists slash 40 percent and revoke earning rights.
